def: Feeding on serpents; -- said of certain birds and reptiles.
A photo-engraving produced by any process involving the etchingof the plate.
A hood; especialy, the hood attached to the gown of a monk.
The process of generation by development of blastema, orfission of cells, in which the new formation is in all respect likethe individual from which it proceeds.

A spinose, plectognath fish of the Allantic coast of the UnitedStates (esp. Chilo mycterus geometricus) having the power ofdistending its body with water or air, so as to resemble a chestnutbur; -- called also ball fish, balloon fish, and swellfish.
An out-of-door flight of steps, as in a garden, leading to aterrace or to an upper story; -- usually applied to mediævel or laterstructures of some architectural pretensions.
A regaining; recovery of something lost. [Obs.] Bacon.
A division of Coleoptera, having heteromerous tarsi.
